title: EV charge point supply
goal: Show the dedicated protected supply, load-management sensing, isolation, and protective-earth connection for an EV charge point.

rubric.must: A QF1 EV MAIN BREAKER rated 40 A, C-curve, 10 kA is visible.
A Q1 TYPE B RCD rated 40 A, 30 mA, Type B is visible.
An S1 EV ISOLATOR is visibly placed between the RCD and the EV charge point.
U1 EV CHARGE POINT is visibly rated 230 V, 32 A, 7.4 kW.
CT1 LOAD MANAGEMENT CT is visible on the incomer and carries a 100 A : 50 mA rating.
A W1 PROTECTIVE EARTH conductor and a T2 MAIN EARTH TERMINAL are visible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Incomer through the current transformer, main breaker, Type B residual current device and local isolator to the charge point, with the transformer's secondary feeding the load manager and a green protective earth of stated cross-section back to the main earth terminal. The supply path is written out along the bottom.
